description: The file defines the InternalClusterClient class which implements IInternalClusterClient. It provides methods for retrieving grain references and managing object references within the Orleans silo cluster.

classes.name: InternalClusterClient
classes.description: A client class responsible for communication with Orleans cluster of silos, providing access to grain interfaces and managing object references.

methods.name: InternalClusterClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InternalClusterClient with runtime and grain factory dependencies.

methods.name: GrainFactory
methods.description: Property returning the grain factory used to create grain references.

methods.name: ServiceProvider
methods.description: Property exposing the service provider from the runtime client.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Overloaded methods to retrieve grain references by different key types (Guid, long, string) with optional class name prefix.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a reference object for a grain observer or addressable object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes a grain observer object reference.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget
methods.description: Retrieves system targets by GrainType or GrainId.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts a grain object to a specified interface type.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a general grain instance by interface type and primary key.

methods.name: GetGrain (by GrainId)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain instance using a GrainId object.

methods.name: GetGrain (by Type and Guid)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain given its interface type and Guid primary key.

methods.name: GetGrain (by Type and long)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain given its interface type and long primary key.

methods.name: GetGrain (by Type and string)
methods.description: Retrieves a grain given its interface type and string primary key.
